description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Fills in a brand's profile — e.g. `{ brandId, profile: { website: "https://…" } }`. Changes only the fields you send; the voice, colors and fonts stay as they are unless you pass them. Use it to clear list_brands setup items such as hasWebsite. Owners, admins and editors only; every change is audited against this connection.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/brand/intelligence.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key is pinned to its own brand (may be omitted; another brand → 403); an account-wide key must name one.

colors.description: REPLACES the brand palette, the same as saving Brand → Overview → Brand Colors: the stored list is primary, secondary, then palette (duplicates dropped); primary and secondary are its top two. 6-digit hex, `#` optional, stored lower case.

fonts.description: Font family names. A role left out keeps its stored font. At least one is required.

profile.description: Only the fields sent are changed. Unknown fields are a 422.

voice.description: The brand default voice. Created (as the default) when the brand has none.

name: brand_profile_update
title: Update a brand profile
